description: This source file defines a generic record class 'PagedResponse' used as a minimal page-like response wrapper for endpoints, providing pagination metadata and aliases for content, designed to emulate Spring Page's shape without depending on Spring Data.

classes.name: PagedResponse
classes.description: A generic record class representing a paginated response with content and metadata, providing JSON aliases for client compatibility.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Returns the content list, aliased as 'categories' for client compatibility.

methods.name: products
methods.description: Returns the content list, aliased as 'products' for client compatibility.

methods.name: numberOfElements
methods.description: Returns the size of the content list, representing the number of elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the content list is empty, i.e., has zero elements.
